owen: Heads up — hitting a parity bug between sync and async Python SDK for embeddings+rerank. Sync rerank returns a flat list of scores but the async client is returning nested lists for the same request. Repro below.

owen: ```py
# sync
resp = client.rerank(document_embeddings, query_embedding)
# resp[0]['scores'] -> [0.91, 0.07, 0.02]

# async
resp = await client.rerank_async(document_embeddings, query_embedding)
# resp[0]['scores'] -> [[0.91, 0.07, 0.02]]  # extra nesting
```

ashley: who owns the embeddings client currently? can you paste exact sdk version?

owen: sdk==0.8.6. noticed this only when using EmbeddingBatcher helper with page_size>1. quick log: `repr(resp)` shows `'scores': [[0.9, 0.1]]` for each item.

sanjay: sounds like the batcher yields batches as items rather than flattening per document. could be the helper wrapping each document in a list. any stack trace?

owen: small stack: `embedding_batcher._build_batch -> return [items] -> client._send` then the async path `await client._send_async` which doesn't unwrap.

maria: i think our typings are inconsistent too — the sync stub is typed as `List[float]` for scores but async typing might be `List[List[float]]`. pyright flagged the async client in my local run.

nick: quick workaround if you hit this in prod:
```py
# normalize scores
scores = resp[0]['scores']
if isinstance(scores[0], list):
    scores = [s[0] for s in scores]  # collapse extra nesting
```
This is ugly but avoids a hard crash.

ci-bot: test failure: tests/embeddings/test_rerank.py::test_async_rerank_shape — 1 assertion failed on linux-py3.11 (see CI job 4821).

ashley: i'll take ownership. i'll open an issue and a tiny unit test that asserts parity between sync/async shapes. @maria will you handle typing patch? @nick can you look at batcher logic? :thumbsup:

maria: will add typing fix. plan: widen stub to `Union[List[float], List[List[float]]]` then normalize in runtime or add a small `unwrap_scores` util with a comment. will run pyright.

nick: i'll try to reproduce locally with page_size=2 and add a fix to EmbeddingBatcher._prepare that ensures we flatten per document when serializing.

owen: created a minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/fake-repro (includes async/sync call and failing assertion). linked the CI failure. updating thread after i push tests.
